name: Firmfoot
description: Plant the feet and the will together so a charging foe meets a body that does not shift.

name: Steadfast Palm
description: Drive an open palm into the foe's chest from a stance that has not moved an inch.

name: Mettle Count
description: Count how much strength of will is left in the user and in the allies at the user's side.

name: Calm Shoulder
description: Rest a hand on the shoulder of an ally and pass a pulse of calm that loosens the ally's stiffened limbs.

name: Stalwart Blow
description: Throw a heavy blow from a braced frame that lands with the weight of everything the user has endured so far.

name: Shared Brace
description: Share one braced stance with the allies at the user's shoulder so a hard blow is spread among them and none falls.

name: Panic Draining
description: Drain the panic out of the allies near the user with one level word so clear thought comes back to all of them.

name: Unwavering Charge
description: Hurl the body through a screen of blows with the eyes fixed past them and strike at the end of the run.

name: Standing Mantle
description: Wrap the user in a standing mantle of will that thickens with each blow it takes and does not bow.

name: Kindling Jab
description: Jab with a small hot spark of will that grows brighter each time the jab lands.

name: Welcomed Sting
description: Take a glancing blow on purpose and let the sting wake the will instead of dulling it.

name: Blaze Reading
description: Read how hot the will of a foe is running to tell whether the foe is tiring or only now catching fire.

name: Hot Word
description: Bark one hard word that strikes sparks in a sagging ally and brings the ally back to the fight.

name: Elevating Step
description: Gain a short pace on each exchange by stepping up into the foe's blow rather than back from it.

name: Fanned Strike
description: Fan the glow of will into a strike that hits harder for every wound the user already carries.

name: Wound Fuel
description: Turn the pain of a fresh wound into steady heat and keep the guard up while it burns.

name: Spreading Blaze
description: Spread the heat of the user's will into the allies within reach so all of them grow fiercer at once.

name: Blazing Surge
description: Release all the heat gathered over a long fight in one searing blow that the foe cannot take head on.

name: Burning Tenacity
description: Keep a steady burn of will running into one ally so that ally does not slow however long the fight runs.

name: Presence Feel
description: Feel the will of those inside a wide circle round the user and find the one who is closest to falling.

name: Spanning Palm
description: Strike with a broad palm whose reach is lengthened by the field of will round the arm.

name: Will Rooting
description: Root the user's stance in the field of will so the ground itself seems to push back against a shove.

name: Upholding Word
description: Speak one word through the field that props up every ally who hears it for the next several breaths.

name: Wide Calm
description: Send a wave of calm through the field to wash the fear out of a rattled company.

name: Unbroken Bow
description: Hold the field taut across the front of the group so the line bends under force and never breaks.

name: Will Anchor
description: Drop an anchor of will into the field that holds every ally to the ground and feeds each of them strength.

name: Heartcall
description: Haul back an ally whose breath has just stopped by refusing through the field to let the heart stop; the window is short and every use is a heavy consequence.

name: Shoulder Stance
description: Stand shoulder to shoulder with the line and hold the front against a push.

name: Level Cross
description: Throw a crossing blow level with the chest of the foe with the whole line's weight in the shoulder.

name: Wary Sense
description: Sweep a wary thread of attention over the line to catch the first sign of a wavering comrade.

name: Heartening Cry
description: Raise a short firm cry that settles the nerves of every ally in earshot.

name: Stalling Press
description: Press a braced shoulder into a charging foe so the charge stalls and the foe's footing is lost.

name: Calm Spread
description: Spread one steady calm from the user down the line until the whole line breathes together.

name: Unflinching Front
description: Hold a guard of will across the front that does not flinch from fire or fear.

name: Lofted Blow
description: Raise both fists on a rising breath and bring them down in one crushing blow that the line follows.

name: Bright Bearing
description: Hold a bright steady bearing that the allies around the user mirror until their own resolve is as clear.

name: Vow Stance
description: Stand as if a sworn word were nailed to the spot and let the blow break on the oath.

name: Pledge Strike
description: Strike once with the full weight of a promise to hit the one chosen mark.

name: Clear Point
description: Find the one fixed point of will in a melee that the rest of the fight turns round.

name: Blue Calm
description: Wash an ally in a cold clear calm that cuts through haze and hurry.

name: Oathed Step
description: Take a step that was decided before the fight began and cannot be turned back.

name: Pledged Parry
description: Parry a strike with the forearm in the exact line a pledge would stand.

name: Unwavering Point
description: Fix the gaze on one foe and press a clear point of will on that foe until the foe's own resolve slackens.

name: Pledge Renewal
description: Speak the vow again over a faltering ally and renew in that ally the force that the first swearing gave.

name: Wavering Mend
description: Mend the cracked nerve of an ally who has begun to waver and draw off the doubt that opened the crack.

name: Clear Resolve
description: Hold a clear point of resolve so a domineering aura or a terror-shout slides off the user and fails.

name: Fulfilled Vow
description: Gather every promise kept into a single blow that falls at the end of a long count and cannot be turned aside.

name: Ascent Stance
description: Lean into a blow as if climbing a steep slope and let the lean carry the force upward and away.

name: Climbing Fist
description: Throw a rising fist whose force builds as the body lifts through the blow.

name: Grade Reading
description: Judge how steep the fight has become for the user and the allies by the weight pressing on each of them.

name: Pulling Hand
description: Clasp a flagging ally's hand and pull while the field of will lends the ally the strength to rise.

name: Upward Step
description: Take one hard rising step onto a higher footing and strike from above.

name: Rarefied Breath
description: Show an ally how to breathe thin and slow when the body cries out for more air so the ally keeps moving.

name: Ascending Strike
description: Drive a strike up from the knees through the chest and chin of the foe in a single rising line.

name: Weary Mending
description: Draw the leaden weariness of overwork out of an ally and replace it with an even flow of will.

name: Limitless Blow
description: Strike from beyond the point where the body should have stopped with force that was thought spent.

name: Hauling Resolve
description: Haul a faltering ally up through the field by lending that ally the user's own will until the ally stands on a firm footing.

name: Mast Brace
description: Brace into the oncoming force like a mast into a gale and lean until it passes.

name: Endure Fist
description: Hit with a fist that keeps its weight at the end of a very long exchange.

name: Breath Measure
description: Measure the breath of the user and the allies to learn how long each can go on at this pace.

name: Shared Oath
description: Call the oath all share and let it lift every voice that answers.

name: Leaning Step
description: Lean the whole body into each step and let the wind of the move keep the pace.

name: Wind Parry
description: Turn aside a strike with a sweep of the arm so light it seems the wind did it.

name: Outlasting Blow
description: Wait out the first storm of blows and strike at the exact moment the foe's strength gives.

name: Reed Guard
description: Bend with the force of a strike and spring back whole without breaking the guard.

name: Gust Cleansing
description: Blow the lingering taint of a curse or a binding off an ally with a hard clean breath.

name: Rousing Gale
description: Send a rousing wind of will through the allies at the user's back so they stand and fight on.

name: Gale Unbowed
description: Throw a battering blow that carries the whole weight of a gale endured and not yielded to.

name: Storm Enduring
description: Stand in the full roar of a crushing aura and let the will cancel its hold on the user.

name: Oath Stance
description: Take a stance chosen long ago and give up no ground from it.

name: Word Strike
description: Strike on the last syllable of a sworn word so the blow lands with the word's weight.

name: Oath Sense
description: Sense whether those near the user still hold to the word they swore.

name: Sworn Lift
description: Lift a falling ally with the weight of a shared oath spoken through the field.

name: Breaker Weight
description: Speak the oath aloud and let its weight settle on a foe who broke a word and slow the foe's every move.

name: Oath Mending
description: Mend the strain of a broken pledge in an ally so the shame lets go of the ally's qi.

name: Kept Oath
description: Hold a sworn word as a great shield over the group and let the word strengthen every one who stands under it.

name: Called Oath
description: Call the whole oath down at once in a single blow that lands on the breaker of the word.

name: Willbrace
description: Brace the stance against a squall of blows and wait for the first gap.

name: Tempered Knuckle
description: Hit with knuckles beaten hard by long storms and many exchanges.

name: Squall Reading
description: Read the rise and fall of a fight like weather and tell when the worst has passed.

name: Steady Gust
description: Breathe a steady gust of will past an ally and carry away the ally's wavering.

name: Tempest Step
description: Step through the eye of a flurry of strikes and out on the other side unmarked.

name: Squall Strike
description: Hit the foe in a quick stormy flurry that ends in one heavy blow.

name: Fuel Draw
description: Draw the force of a heavy blow into the will as fuel and pass part of it to an ally.

name: Cleansing Gust
description: Scour a poison or a curse from an ally in a long cleansing wind of will.

name: Brink Recall
description: Call back an ally whose pulse has just been cut by willing the ally to stay; the window is short and the use is a heavy consequence.

name: Tempered Surge
description: Surge forward with every storm survived behind the blow and shatter the foe's guard.
